title: Pricing — Paygent | Free, Starter, Pro & Scale Plans
snippet:

### Starter

[ Start with Starter ](https://app.paygent.to/signin)

### Pro
Growing usage across a few products.

- 250 active users/mo
- 250,000 events/mo
- 3 products
[ Start with Pro ](https://app.paygent.to/signin)
### Scale
High volume, multiple products.
$99 /mo
- 1,000 active users/mo
- 1,000,000 events/mo
- 3 products
[ Start with Scale ](https://app.paygent.to/signin)
### Included in every tier
Per-user, per-model cost metering
Soft and hard spending guardrails
Python & TypeScript SDKs — OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK
Gate-event audit trail
Usage dashboard & query API
Email support

Free is a one-month trial of the full product. No credit card required to start. Limits reset each calendar month.
